description: SDPA backward in the ASM_SDPA_ENGINE region on gfx942 (SdpaBwdPlanBuilder.cpp; asm_kernels/gfx942/fmha_v3_bwd/fmha_bwd_dqdkdv.csv): half or bfloat16, head size 64, 128 or 192 with dqk == dv, BSHD or BHSD. The builder dispatches the A32 kernels with pssk = 1 and pddv = 1 and no group mode (computeDispatchTuples), so a case runs only where the CSV ships that row: head size 128 with every mask (none, top-left causal, bottom-right causal, sliding window), head size 192 with the first three, both dtypes. Head size 64 ships only pddv = 0 rows and a sliding window at head size 192 has no row: both decline and stay as probes. So do grouped-query heads, which isApplicable rejects (Hq != Hkv: the kernel indexes dK and dV by query head), and an alignment below 16 bytes (K_ROW_ALIGNMENT_BYTES); a quarter of the samples draw a group above 1. The mask goes through the template's left_bound, right_bound and diagonal_alignment, which follow the cuDNN left_bound semantics (L keeps the L keys ending at the diagonal, diagonal included; resolveDiagonalBand() turns it into the kernels' L - 1, develop #14483); a window that covers the whole span collapses to no mask or plain causal, as the builder classifies it. The softmax scale is set per sample by a node patch on the node's attn_scale_value (the template holds the literal 1/sqrt(128)). O and the LSE are not inputs of this space: the harness derives them from Q, K and V by the CPU forward (SdpaBackwardInputs.cpp, run by fillInputs after every fill and before the engine), so an inputs recipe for uid 1 or 8 would be overwritten and the space gives none. The domain axis fills Q, K, V and dO. wide and large widen only Q and K (large at scale 8, as SdpaFwd, so Q.K of a 192-wide head stays inside the half range): the gradients grow with |dO| * |V| (dP = dO V^T) and the engine tolerances are calibrated on data of magnitude 1 (ASM_SDPA_ENGINE.toml), so V and dO keep (-1, 1) there and positive uses (0.25, 1) for them; PROVISIONAL, to be checked against the on-device run. The nan and inf domains are excluded: one non-finite element of dO makes D = sum(dO * O) and dP non-finite for its row, so dS is non-finite across that whole row and dK (a sum of dS * Q over the rows) has no finite element (CpuFpReferenceSdpa.hpp backward, steps 1-4); a non-finite element of Q, K or V reaches whole rows or columns of the derived O and LSE the same way (SdpaFwd documents it for Q and K). The non-finite mask fails a reference with no finite element (NonFiniteMask.hpp), so no operand keeps the outputs partly finite. The cost ceiling b * hq * sq * skv * (dqk + dv) <= 2**29 was measured on a gfx942 MI325X host: the case time is linear above 2**26 at about 45 ns per cost unit (2**30 takes about 48 s, 2**31 about 91 s), so 2**29 keeps the worst drawn case near 24 s. The CPU backward reference is serial (CpuFpReferenceSdpa.hpp, 'cannot be parallelized without atomics') and the reference-affordability gate covers the golden lanes only (ReferenceOpCoverage.cpp referenceShapeIsAffordable, called from GoldenDataPlan.cpp), so the space carries the bound.

derive.stride_q: [sq*hq*d, d, hq*d, 1] if layout == 'bshd' else [hq*sq*d, sq*d, d, 1]
derive.stride_kv: [skv*hkv*d, d, hkv*d, 1] if layout == 'bshd' else [hkv*skv*d, skv*d, d, 1]
derive.right: 0 if mask in ['causal_top_left', 'causal_bottom_right'] else (wr if mask == 'window' else None)
derive.rows_see_a_key: (right == None or diag + right >= 0) and (left == None or sq + diag - left <= skv - 1)
derive.dom_kind: 'fixed' if domain == 'constant' else ('free' if domain in ['default', 'narrow', 'wide', 'positive'] else domain)
derive.dom_lo: -0.01 if domain == 'narrow' else (-8 if domain == 'wide' else (0.25 if domain == 'positive' else (0.5 if domain == 'constant' else -1)))
derive.dom_hi: 0.01 if domain == 'narrow' else (8 if domain == 'wide' else (4 if domain == 'positive' else (0.5 if domain == 'constant' else 1)))
derive.eff_placement: 'exact' if placement == 'under' and alignment < 2 else placement

constraints.reason: a query row with no key left under the mask has an LSE of -inf in the derived stats (CpuFpReferenceSdpa.hpp forward, 'fully masked rows'), which is not an input the backward kernels define; SdpaFwd excludes the same samples (bottom-right causal needs sq <= skv). A key that no row sees is fine: its dK and dV are zero

Measured cost ceiling. On a gfx942 MI325X host the case time is linear above 2**26 at about 45 ns per cost unit (2**30 takes about 48 s, 2**31 about 91 s), so 2**29 keeps the worst drawn case near 24 s. The case includes the CPU backward reference, which is serial (CpuFpReferenceSdpa.hpp:624-628), and no gate caps it in the fuzz path (referenceShapeIsAffordable, ReferenceOpCoverage.cpp:139-207, gates the golden lanes only: GoldenDataPlan.cpp:115)
